incident-bot: HIGH SEV — multiple 500s and misrouted outputs on /v1/inference for customer Carver. Autoscaling healthy, but traffic showing fallback loop to an incompatible 'chat' variant after a pin change. Pager assigned: Erin (on-call). Please ACK. :rotating_light:
Erin (on-call): Acked. Jumping in. Any owner for the routing/pin change?
Priya (sre): I see spikes starting 2024-11-05T01:12Z in eu-west-1. Error pattern: gen requests returned schema mismatch errors when runtime attempted chat-variant. Logs: `variant_mismatch: chat_instruct -> expected: gen_instruct`
Marcus (runtime): That sounds like a pin to a variant with different I/O contract. Checking model-pin history...
Marcus (runtime): `rbacctl get-pin --route carver.embedding.v1` -> pinned: model=redwood-chat-v2, variant=chat, pinned_at=2024-11-05T01:05Z by deploy-bot
Sasha (platform): Who pushed that pin? It looks automated from a rollout job. Might be a bad alias mapping from the new alias-sync job.
Alex (support): Customer Carver reporting failed batch embeddings and timeouts. They see 500s and degraded quality. Customer impacted on production. They've opened a ticket. Jamie (cs) is looped.
Jamie (cs): Carver says "loss of embeddings for recommendation pipeline, major regression". They're asking for ETA.
Priya (sre): Mitigation plan: 1) remove pin (rollback) for the route 2) apply emergency routing override to prefer family gen variants 3) throttle traffic to eu-west-1 if still looping. Can we do step 1 now?
Erin (on-call): Do step 2 first so traffic doesn't keep hitting pinned variant during rollback. Sasha, can you push the emergency routing override? Use policy `force_model_family: gen` on route `carver.embedding.v1`.
Sasha (platform): Applying override now. Pushing patch: `rbacctl set-routing-override --route carver.embedding.v1 --policy '{"force_model_family":"gen"}'`
PagerDuty-Bot: Action logged: routing-override applied by Sasha at 2024-11-05T01:22Z.
Marcus (runtime): Override accepted by routing service. Checking active host connections... still seeing some cached prefixes in LV cache that route to chat variant. I'll clear per-route KV caches.
Marcus (runtime): `runtime-admin cache-clear --route carver.embedding.v1 --type kv` -> cleared.
Priya (sre): Now rolling back pin: `rbacctl unset-pin --route carver.embedding.v1 --pin-id 0x7f3a` -> confirmed.
Alex (support): Customer notified: we applied an emergency routing override and rolled back the pin. Asking them to confirm whether their pipeline can resume.
Jamie (cs): Carver confirms some jobs are coming back healthy, but a portion of historic requests still failing. They reported a spike of ~14% error rate between 01:12Z-01:25Z.
Erin (on-call): Good. Priya, Marcus — can you watch for residual 500s and check whether any other routes share the bad alias? Also scan for recent alias-sync jobs around 01:00-01:10Z.
Priya (sre): Scanning... alias-sync job 2024-11-05T01:04Z touched aliases: carver/* and partner-anchors. It looks like a mapping rule incorrectly translated `gen_instruct` -> `chat` on routes with suffix `.embedding.v1` due to a regex bug.
Marcus (runtime): Confirmed. Found 3 other routes that were affected but no active traffic. I'll push a hotfix to alias-sync to add a stricter match and roll it out to the alias-sync job queue. Patch: `fix: anchor-suffix match for embeddings`
Sasha (platform): Hotfix queued and will be deployed as a canary. No mass rollout until we confirm.
Erin (on-call): Customer impact: partial (14% transient errors, some degraded embeddings). Mitigation: override + unset-pin + cache-clear + alias-sync hotfix queued. Recommend postmortem and corrective action: add pre-deploy checks for alias-sync that validate variant contract compatibility.
Alex (support): Carver appreciates the quick mitigation. They requested an incident summary and timeline. Jamie, please own the customer post-incident communication.
Jamie (cs): Taking ownership of customer comms. Will provide ETA for summary in 2 hours.
Erin (on-call): Handoff: I'm handing to Priya for the next 4 hours of monitoring. Priya, please page me if error rate exceeds 1% for >10min or any rollback fails to re-stabilize. Marcus will own the postmortem with Sasha and Alex will help with customer timeline.
Priya (sre): ACK. Setting watch. Creating incident tracking ticket: INC-2024-1105-2398765432. I'll attach logs and the pinned model history.
Marcus (runtime): Postmortem owner: Marcus. RCA notes: incorrect alias-sync mapping created incompatible pin on embeddings route; missing contract validation in alias-sync.
Erin (on-call): Thanks team. Closing pager for me now but Priya stays on watch. We'll schedule a quick postmortem meeting tomorrow. :thumbsup:
incident-bot: INCIDENT UPDATE | status=mitigated, severity=high -> monitoring. All actions logged.
Priya (sre): Final note before handover: add an automated regression test that simulates embedding routes through alias-sync to catch variant mapping mismatches. I'll file a ticket.
Jamie (cs): I'll include the mitigation timeline in the customer note.
Alex (support): Leaving logs and example failing request payload in the incident ticket.
Erin (on-call): End of thread for me.
